nodes.title: Binary enhanced mod-4 coordinates and phase-corrected physical stabilizer labels
nodes.remaining: Actual all-state, target, prior and all-POVM binary bridge is closed, preserving full ZMod 4 phases. Separate literal W_A/W_C and verifier-projector interfaces in the wider source section remain open.

nodes.title: Uniform O(n) finite errors and polynomial largest-term bound on full feasible domains
nodes.semantic_scope: Complete actual positive-mass support and original finite completion domain. Exact finite-to-real conversion gives ordinary correction at most k and binary correction at most zero, all ranks uniformly; augmented dimension is removed by proved cost monotonicity. The clipped scalar objective has exact maximum -J on the full closed domain. Proved support cardinality and explicit logarithmic remainder yield o(N^2) for every source scaling sequence. alpha=0, beta=1, transition, zero-rank and all finite feasibility boundaries are covered; no universal convergence threshold for all arbitrary little-o sequences is claimed.

nodes.remaining: Full scalar feasible-domain optimization and attained clipped maximum equal to -J, including all boundary regimes, are closed in the accepted uniform-asymptotic and current physical chain.

overview_status: Exact original Main is proved and passes identical-source Mac clean/Linux fresh audit; separate paper interfaces retain scoped statuses.

validation.main_theorem_axiom_audit: Exact-type strict gate passed; full recursive allowlist audit passed.

phase-completeness.paper_coverage: Full equivalence between arbitrary original compatible complex-phase assignments and the finite ZMod(2p) encoding; the root-of-unity condition follows from compatibility.
phase-completeness.remaining: All primes and zero dimension; no claim of gauge transport for an arbitrary section.

pauli-representation.paper_coverage: Multiplication, unitarity, trace, and commutation for isotropic assignments in the actual XZ section are proved.
pauli-representation.remaining: The original XZ section is fixed; actual Clifford implementation of arbitrary symplectic transformations with full phase correction is now proved.

projectors.paper_coverage: The complete projector family over all original assignments: existence, exact count, orthogonality, resolution of the identity, joint eigenspaces, and exact ranks.
projectors.remaining: Assignment existence and resolution of the identity are closed within the proof, without an externally supplied reference assignment.

stabilizer-ensemble.paper_coverage: A bijection between all valid Lagrangian labels and the original distinct pure stabilizer density matrices.
stabilizer-ensemble.remaining: A closed formula for the total number of all Lagrangians or all states is not yet proved; the correspondence stated by this node is closed.

section-bridges.paper_coverage: Actual P_id for standard and arbitrary public frames, the original fixed-W finite exact comparison, and uniform J are closed, preserving the complete target and all POVMs.
section-bridges.remaining: The literal phase-adjusted Weyl/W_A/W_C operators, named verifier operators, and interfaces specific to refined verification remain partially open; the original physical bridges, complete converse, direct result, and Main have been accepted.

nonempty.paper_coverage: Nonemptiness of the original stabilizer input set, reports for every valid W, and the set of all learner POVMs is established by construction.
nonempty.remaining: Actual nonemptiness is proved; nonempty report or measurement sets are not added as new hypotheses.

exact-criterion.paper_coverage: The original physical Valid predicate is exactly equivalent to containment of K in the input Lagrangian and restriction of the assignment; multiple correct reports for exceptional inputs are retained.
exact-criterion.remaining: The complete original report event is closed; it is not replaced by a canonical label, and target uniqueness is not assumed.

probabilities.paper_coverage: Positivity and normalization of the original tensorPower density, actual Born weights, [0,1] bounds for pointwise scores, both aggregations, and all four optima, and the sharp affine comparison are closed.
probabilities.remaining: The sup_M inf_x order and the original uniform prior on distinct states are preserved; actual fixed-W report/learner nonemptiness is also proved in this round.

luders-reduction.paper_coverage: The original normalization on positive-probability branches, zero-probability branches, averaging over all assignments, score exactly one for correct reports, and score ≤1/p for incorrect reports are proved without assuming the key bounds.
luders-reduction.remaining: The averaged identity does not assert equality of conditional scores for each ν. A fixed 1/p remainder cannot imply convergence to zero; the original verification converse is now closed using actual phase-compatible lists and a tail that vanishes with D.

covariance-rates.paper_coverage: Covariance over all W, all POVMs, an actual rate-one witness, both original liminf/sInf exact rates, and the original Main are closed.
